race.comment: BETTY'S BOY (2) has to find this easier than the two outings at the Sunshine Coast. He now gets some blinkers added from a lovely barrier. It just looks like he should be doing no work early and from there proving to be strong late. WHEELER DEALER (5) showed good improvement second time around. That came when leading so if fit enough, he might head forward again. RADOMIR (3) is hard fit now. His runs came against better maidens in town and has trialled against them recently. Has to be a place hope. RATTLESNAKEWHISKEY (4) will sit right up with the leaders here. He just has to overcome a tricky draw so placings look best.
